entries.scenario: Run an existing conformant napplet without modification
entries.falsifier: Run a pinned published artifact byte-for-byte and fail if any source, build, manifest, or runtime import change is required.

entries.scenario: Drop a message from an unmapped source window
entries.falsifier: A sibling frame sends a valid privileged envelope; any native provider observation fails the invariant.

entries.scenario: Restore a workspace and reattach a receipt
entries.falsifier: Static dependency inspection and restart proof fail if a mechanism crate is imported or receipt semantics are reimplemented outside the NMP facade.
Destroy the originating component and fail if the accepted write obligation or canonical pending row disappears.

entries.scenario: Mount a renderer with an initial snapshot
entries.falsifier: Mutate only component-local state and fail if it can become the authoritative host binding value.
Inspect iframe globals and bridge reachability; any key, signer, native bridge, or window.nostr fails.

entries.scenario: Do not silently inherit sensitive grants on update
entries.falsifier: Install a same-author/dTag artifact with a new aggregate hash and fail if an upload grant transfers without a new explicit approval.

entries.scenario: One napplet exceeds its message-rate limit
entries.falsifier: Flood one session and fail if memory is unbounded, refusal is silent, or a healthy sibling stops responding.

entries.scenario: Launch an installed component while offline
entries.falsifier: Launch from cached rows with no network and fail if evidence claims global sync, completeness, or authoritative emptiness.

entries.scenario: Replace a feed renderer without restarting demand
entries.falsifier: Record binding/NMP observation identity across A-to-B replacement and fail on close, reopen, state loss, write retarget, or navigation reset.
